title: Compatibility becomes a weighted value
purpose: One query scores two visible keys, normalizes scores and combines corresponding value rows.
contract: q [2], K [3,2], V [3,2]; query position t = 1
scores = Kq / √2; future position 2 is masked
α = softmax(scores + mask); output = Σⱼ αⱼVⱼ
